name: Threads
summary:
Threads is the short-post app at threads.com (threads.net redirects there). Its tab icon is separate from the Instagram glyph even though both are Meta products.

Checked 12 November 2026 against threads.com. HTML came from https://www.threads.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon 192x192 → https://static.cdninstagram.com/rsrc.php/yP/r/0Qa-AOmHi0c.ico.

The favicon.ico URL is https://static.cdninstagram.com/rsrc.php/yP/r/0Qa-AOmHi0c.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 32038 bytes. Directory sizes: 64×64, 48×48, 32×32, 16×16.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

The only measured sizes are inside favicon.ico: 64×64, 48×48, 32×32, 16×16.
